meta.name: context-driven-development
meta.description: Creates and maintains project context artifacts (product.md, tech-stack.md, workflow.md, tracks.md) in a `conductor/` directory. Scaffolds new projects from scratch, extracts context from existing codebases, validates artifact consistency before implementation, and synchronizes documents as the project evolves. Use when setting up a project, creating or updating product docs, managing a tech stack file, defining development workflows, tracking work units, onboarding to an existing codebase, or running project scaffolding.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 为新老项目搭好文档骨架,让产品、技术与流程说明始终同步
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果团队项目缺一份统一的产品与技术说明,或你刚接手陌生代码库
copy.tagline_en: Scaffold a project's docs and keep product, stack, and workflow notes in sync
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your team lacks one place for product and tech notes, or you're new to a codebase

howto.what: 它会在项目里维护 conductor/ 目录下的上下文文档(product.md、tech-stack.md、workflow.md、tracks.md),给新项目搭骨架、从已有代码提取上下文,并在实现前校验文档是否一致。
howto.when: 当你新建项目、创建或更新产品文档、管理技术栈文件等场景时触发;给已有代码库做上手了解也适用。

say.text: 实现前先校验一下 conductor/ 里的文档是否一致。
say.note: 按校验清单检查上下文一致性

howto.when_en: Use when setting up a project, creating or updating product docs, managing a tech stack file, onboarding to an existing codebase, or scaffolding a project.
